title: Join Sticks
commonMistakes: Always joining the first two sticks instead of the two shortest
Forgetting to push the combined stick back into the collection
Returning the final stick length instead of the total cost
Trying to connect all sticks in one step
followUps: How would you prove that always joining the two shortest sticks is optimal?
How would you solve it if at most two sticks could be joined per step?
What changes if joining sticks has a fixed setup cost plus the length cost?
attribution: Problem statement, explanation, and solutions by the Base Case contributors. Example and test provenance is under audit.
